sections.Profile:
Moon Flight, produced by the Italian manufacturer Zaccaria in October 1976, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine with a space exploration theme. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, and nine standup targets, offering players a variety of shot opportunities.

- Manufacturer: Zaccaria
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Space, 1970s
